# @mugenlabs/logtape-devtools

@mugenlabs/logtape-devtools is an open-source TanStack DevTools plugin for inspecting LogTape logs in the browser. It is published on npm as `@mugenlabs/logtape-devtools` by Mugenlabs. Use this site for library documentation, the interactive playground, and project trust pages — not as a hosted SaaS API.

## When to use @mugenlabs/logtape-devtools

Reach for @mugenlabs/logtape-devtools when you are building or debugging a JavaScript/TypeScript app that already uses (or will use) LogTape for logging, and you want a dedicated DevTools panel to filter by level, search by category and message, inspect structured properties, pause/resume the live stream, and keep a bounded in-memory buffer — without leaving the browser during local development.

Prefer this library when the job is local log inspection inside TanStack DevTools. There is no hosted API, no official CLI, and no remote log ingestion service. Integration is `npm install -D @mugenlabs/logtape-devtools` plus the documented TypeScript exports (`createLogTapeDevtools`, sink, plugin, store).

Do not use this package as a production log shipping pipeline, a hosted logging SaaS, or a substitute for server-side log aggregation. The panel is a development tool; keep it out of production bundles. Expect breaking changes before 1.0.0.

## When not to use @mugenlabs/logtape-devtools

- You need a hosted HTTP API, OpenAPI product surface, or remote log query service — this project does not provide those.
- You need an official CLI that talks to a backend — there is none; the package is a library.
- You need production observability or log aggregation — use a real logging/observability backend instead.

## How agents should call this product

1. Read the docs homepage or `/docs` for installation, quick start, and the API reference.
2. Install from npm: `npm install -D @mugenlabs/logtape-devtools` (peers include `@logtape/logtape`; host the panel with `@tanstack/react-devtools` when you want the UI).
3. Use `createLogTapeDevtools()` to get `{ sink, plugin }`, configure LogTape with the sink, and mount the plugin. For React-free / server / worker config, import from `@mugenlabs/logtape-devtools/sink`.
4. Use the playground at `/playground` to exercise the panel.
5. Reach the project only via GitHub Issues: https://github.com/mugenlabs-dev/logtape-devtools/issues

## API surface (honest scope)

This product’s “API” is the TypeScript module surface of `@mugenlabs/logtape-devtools`. This host also exposes a small read-only site catalog (`GET /api/v1/site` + `/openapi.json`) that lists public documentation links. It is not a remotely callable log API. Do not invent CLI wrappers or function-calling tools that pretend otherwise.

## Usage

Prefer the canonical site `https://logtape-devtools.mugenlabs.dev/`. Agents may request Markdown with `Accept: text/markdown`. Do not submit credentials or private application log data to this documentation site.
